allocations.exactDerivedText: Claude is folding quick questions and longer Cowork jobs into one conversation
Anthropic announced September 16 that it is merging Claude chat and Cowork into one Claude experience.
A person can ask a quick question or hand over a longer, multi-step task without choosing a mode first.
Rollout is gradual: Pro and Max first across web, desktop and mobile. Team and Free follow; Enterprise gets at least 30 days’ notice. Same-plan accounts may differ.
Until your account moves, the closest alternative is separate Claude Chat for questions and Cowork for longer jobs.
Anthropic says Manual asks before actions; Auto reduces check-ins. The setting covers the conversation.
Those are vendor descriptions, not proof a task will finish well.
Local work needs Claude Desktop open; cloud work may continue after the laptop closes. If separate Chat and Cowork choices remain, keep using them.
Claude is removing the mode choice, not the need to choose permissions.
